active.name: AI Infrastructure Build-Out — Mega-Cap Compute & Software
active.thesis: Institutional capital is concentrating into the AI compute stack — silicon (NVDA, INTC), infrastructure software (MSFT, PLTR), and the platform/ad layer monetizing inference (META, AAPL). With VIX at 15.88, bullish put/call, and SPY above 50SMA, the TRANSITIONAL regime is being expressed through quality mega-cap tech rather than broad risk-on, suggesting capital is rotating UP the quality curve rather than out.
active.evidence: XLK accel_ratio 1.715 and QQQ accel_ratio 3.323 (14d bull rate 3.3x the 60d baseline) show genuine fresh acceleration, not just persistence. Software-Infrastructure (1.992) and Consumer Electronics (2.246) are leading the doubling-up.

active.name: Natural Gas Reversal — Early Commodity Flip
active.thesis: Natural gas has flipped from ACCELERATING_BEARISH to bullish (+0.37%/day 14d) while crude oil and broader energy commodities (USO, BNO, DBC) are flipping the other way — a divergence that historically signals supply-side gas tightening (storage draw, weather, or LNG export demand) independent of macro oil weakness. Early-stage and contrarian to the broader commodity tape.
active.evidence: UNG is the ONLY commodity in the universe with a bearish-to-bullish flip; every other energy and ag commodity is rolling over. The asymmetry is the signal — but 60d base is still -9.96%, so this is an inflection trade, not a confirmed trend.

newsletter:
**[THE SPINE]** Dollar strength is the dominant force this week, and it is doing the heavy lifting under the tape. DXY at 99.98 is up 2.1% on the 21-day, sits above both its 21d and 50d SMAs with RSI 62, and the backtested DXY_METALS_TAG signal is ACTIVE. Everything downstream — the metals washout, the energy softness, the rotation into domestic compute names — traces back to this single thread.

**[CROSS-ASSET LENS]** The macro backdrop ratifies the spine but with frayed edges. Regime is CHOPPY (confidence 4/10, transitional), VIX is in BACKWARDATION at 21.59 (+15.8% on 21d) — a real caution flag against complacency — and the curve is steepening with 5Y +5.8% and 10Y +3.6% on the month. Gold is RSI 26.7 and below its lower Bollinger, Silver RSI 28.6 after a -24.7% 21d collapse; per our rules these are trending oversold, not reverting — and with DXY ACTIVE as a durable headwind (corr -0.45 sustained), I am not reaching for the falling knife. WTI at 89.77 is similarly in a downtrend, not a setup. TLT and the 10Y are posture-only — no ceiling call, no mean-reversion trade.

**[SECTOR & ROTATION LENS]** Money is flowing into compute and defensives, not cyclicals. XLK leads at +8.5% on 21d (ACCELERATING_BULLISH, +12.3% vs 50SMA), XLV at +5.5% is the quiet leader, and rotation flows are concentrated in Consumer Electronics, Software – Infrastructure, and unmapped AI-adjacent names. The other side: QQQ -0.5%, XLI -0.2%, XLP -1.1%. Nothing is rotating *out* yet — no flips, no new exits — which means this is a narrowing tape, not a broadening one.

**[WHERE THE OPPORTUNITY IS]** Semiconductors have already run — HOT 13 months, +258% gain matching the all-time record, CEILING flagged. That is exit-management territory, not entry territory. The in-range setups with smart-money flow sit one layer back: TWLO in Software – Infrastructure (bullish flow, 78.5% coiled, industry only 1 month into a heat spell that typically runs 7) and RDDT in Internet Content & Information (bullish flow, 70.9% coiled, industry 1 month into a typical 6-month run). Both industries are early-innings with runway; both names are coiled rather than extended. That is the asymmetry.

**[WHAT TO WATCH]** The tripwire is DXY 100.54 resistance. A clean break above and the metals/commodity bleed deepens, the AI-domestic-compute trade tightens further, and CHOPPY likely resolves down. A rejection at 100.54 with VIX term structure re-inverting back to contango would be the first real signal that the dollar spine is cracking and breadth can repair. Also note: any bounce in Gold/Silver from here should be treated as a retest candidate, not a bottom — 88% of washout lows get retested within 60 days.
